description: PostgreSQL 18 float4/float8 precision, special values, ordering, indexes, text output, and range errors
sql: SELECT 0.1::float4 AS f4, 0.1::float8 AS f8, 0.1::float4 + 0.2::float4 AS f4_sum, 1::float4 + 1::int4 AS mixed_sum;

SELECT 1e6::float4 AS f4_scientific, 1e-5::float8 AS f8_scientific, 1e-4::float8 AS f8_fixed, '-0'::float8 AS negative_zero, 'Infinity'::float8 AS positive_infinity, '-Infinity'::float8 AS negative_infinity, 'NaN'::float8 AS not_a_number;

SELECT (1e6::float4)::text AS f4_text, (1e-5::float8)::text AS f8_text, (1e-4::float8)::text AS f8_fixed_text, ('-0'::float8)::text AS negative_zero_text, ('Infinity'::float8)::text AS infinity_text, ('NaN'::float8)::text AS nan_text;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_floating_point (label TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value FLOAT8);
SELECT label, value FROM type_matrix_floating_point ORDER BY value, label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT value) AS distinct_count FROM type_matrix_floating_point;
SELECT label FROM type_matrix_floating_point WHERE value = 'NaN'::float8 ORDER BY label;
SELECT label FROM type_matrix_floating_point WHERE value > 'Infinity'::float8 ORDER BY label;
